content:
Maya K.: Heads up — after yesterday's KMS alias rotate some users are getting SCIM deprovision events for the same account. SAML claim `urn:company:entitlement` is flipping between `team:infra` and `team:infra-legacy` for the same external_id. Anyone seen a normalization/race with the claim-normalizer?

Juan P.: We rotated the KMS alias at 03:12 UTC. Do audit logs show any decrypt errors around then?

Samir B.: I spotted a handful of `KMSDecryptException` in idp-proxy logs around 03:13, plus warnings from the claim-normalizer: `WARN claim-normalizer - unknown delimiter, falling back to raw`.

Maya K.: Logs snippet for one affected user (redacted):
```
[03:13:07] idp-proxy ERROR decrypt failed audit_id=abc123 user=ext-998 KMSDecryptException: kms:Decrypt failed: alias/rotated-2026
[03:13:07] claim-normalizer WARN unable to parse entitlement "team:infra\x00\x07" fallback=raw audit_id=abc123
[03:13:08] scim-worker INFO provisioning decision=deprov user=ext-998 reason=entitlement_mismatch audit_id=abc123
```

idp-bot: Automated alert — idp-proxy detected 12 failed decrypts during alias rotate window. Created ticket https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SV-3421 and attached logs.

Juan P.: Can you paste the role-mapping rule we use for that claim? Might be a transform mismatch.

Maya K.: Here's the mapping snippet from our SAML->SCIM pipeline config: 
```
role_mapping:
  - source: "urn:company:entitlement"
    transform: "strip_suffix,lower"
    strip_suffix_delimiter: "-"
    fallback: "legacy_group_map"
```

Samir B.: Ah — `strip_suffix` strips everything after the `-`. If decrypt returns a corrupted tail (non-utf8) the normalizer falls back to raw and later code paths treat `team:infra\x00` != `team:infra-legacy`. Also note scim-worker caches user attributes for 10m; if cache contains pre-rotate value we sometimes end up issuing a deprov after a partial decrypt.

Maya K.: Proposed plan: 1) flush SCIM attribute cache for affected orgs, 2) redeploy claim-normalizer with stricter UTF-8 validation and explicit fallback to keep legacy suffix when parse uncertain, 3) add an idempotency guard to provisioning so deprov requires audit confirmation. I'll create follow-ups.

Juan P.: I can flush cache + restart scim-worker now, then tail the audit stream for `audit_id=abc123`.

Samir B.: Also recommend adding a short backoff window in the provisioning step to avoid acting on transient decrypt errors (e.g., retry decrypt once after 2s).

Maya K.: Created Jira SV-3422 for claim-normalizer hardening and linked SV-3421. Moving runbook details into the ticket.

Juan P.: :thumbsup: cache flush initiated at 03:48 UTC, scim-worker restart triggered. Monitoring logs.

Samir B.: Confirmed — cache flush completed and restart succeeded. No new deprovs observed in audit stream as of 03:55 UTC for affected users.

Maya K.: Great, thanks all. We'll keep the Jira tickets open for the normalization patch and a postmortem.
